note: P4399 (Pro 31:28) — her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her.

dims.v: earned blessedness — the honour her children rise to give her

the blessedness her children rise up to ascribe to her — the honour a life of strength, wisdom, and kindness earns from those closest to it, children moved to bless the mother whose character has shaped them
welded to the praise her husband adds

ashar (call blessed) — 'her children rise up and CALL her BLESSED' (31:28); the truest testimony to her worth is her family's honour. A life of tried excellence earns the blessing of those who know it best (cf 31:31).
cherished worth — the praise her husband adds to the children's blessing
the praise her husband gives her, joining the children's blessing — the cherishing esteem of the one who knows her best, whose heart trusted her (31:11) and who now openly commends her worth
welded to the blessedness her children ascribe

halal (praise) — 'her husband also, and he PRAISES her' (31:28); the husband whose heart trusted in her now praises her openly. Her worth, tried over a lifetime, draws praise from the one closest to her.
